mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in global equity markets, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate leverage.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-rate periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 for three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, prompting equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% triggers a risk-on equity reaction, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors interpret the labor market as resilient and growth supportive.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 102 for two consecutive months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports equity valuation expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansionary supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 3% for three consecutive months suggests the Federal Reserve is likely to keep rates steady, reducing discount rate expectations and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,250,000 units for two consecutive months indicates resilient consumer demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate continued growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in resilient demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for three consecutive months signals a supply-side contraction, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market participants anticipate weaker growth and tighter credit conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
